body:
ub.session_commit() returns False on OperationalError/InvalidRequestError (ub.py:5233-5257, the #1318 contract: callers whose answer depends on the write MUST check it). Unchecked at: HandleTagCreate -> 201 (kobo.py:2290), rename -> 200 (:2329), DELETE via shelf.py:835-844 delete_shelf_helper ignoring the commit and returning True -> 200, HandleTagAddItem -> 201 (:2388), HandleTagRemoveItem -> 200 (:2441). HandleStateRequest (:2708) and the annotation PATCH were fixed; these five sites were not.

A transient SQLite lock (real here — DB contention during ingest is documented) during a device-side collection add/remove/create/rename/delete converts to permanent loss: Kobo uploads collection deltas once. With kobo_only_shelves_sync on, a lost shelf-add also means the book is never delivered. Same family as F-151f59/F-347c16, previously unlisted for the Kobo tag routes.

CONFIDENCE: certain — all four unchecked commit sites OBSERVED independently of the audit agent, 2026-09-01. Fix mirrors the HandleStateRequest pattern. Source: adversarial audit state/kobo-audit-2026-09-01.

resolution.note: Shipped in #2102: all five Kobo collection routes answer 503 on a rolled-back commit; red->green on six routes; main Test Suite green on bae46d9d4e.

title: All four Kobo collection handlers answer success on a rolled-back commit; the device clears its delta queue and the shelf operation is permanently lost
